includes: receipt ordering, durability, observation loss, and reconciliation

normative_rules.scenario_identity: stable_id values are immutable within this schema major version; changed semantics require a new stable_id or schema major version
normative_rules.equivalence: equivalent normalized inputs must produce the same expected_typed_outcome type, disposition, semantic state or decision, and receipt assertions; host-native metadata may differ only where an assertion explicitly permits it
normative_rules.missing_evidence: absence of required evidence is never success and resolves to not_observed or observation_failed
normative_rules.support_claim: a host is conformant only for the exact source, package, runtime, adapter, host, platform, contract, and scenario-suite versions named by its evidence bundle
normative_rules.reader_policy: readers reject unknown schema major versions and may ignore unknown additive fields within a supported major version

implementation_wave_owners.W1/MH-02: neutral lifecycle, policy, and typed result core
implementation_wave_owners.W1/MH-06: ordered durable receipt and observability spine

implementation_wave_owners.W5/MH-09: release-bound distribution evidence and pinned consumer contracts

scenario_field_contract.preconditions: non-empty array of independently establishable facts
scenario_field_contract.action_event: object with one closed-vocabulary event name and deterministic input
scenario_field_contract.expected_typed_outcome: object with a closed-vocabulary type, one terminal disposition, and machine-checkable assertions
scenario_field_contract.evidence_requirements: non-empty array referencing a declared evidence profile and scenario-specific assertions
scenario_field_contract.implementation_wave_owner: object naming exactly one declared wave/work-item owner
